findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3fs is she lies upon it (3ms resumptive of כל); יטמא 3ms is the thing that becomes unclean. Spanish makes todo the one who lies upon él.
findings.spanishSpan: todo lo que se acueste sobre él

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3fs is she sits upon it; the 3ms suffix and יטמא refer to the thing. Spanish makes todo the one who sits upon él.
findings.spanishSpan: todo lo que se siente sobre él

notes: בנדתה as en su menstruación matches the 3fs suffix and stays on the first clause only.
